tutorial.cna.one.title: One visit, two jobs
tutorial.cna.one.body: Sorety puts the turn and the change on the same walk. It does not save video.
tutorial.cna.two.title: An alert is a window
tutorial.cna.two.body: The screen names the person, the room, and why the visit is due.
tutorial.cna.three.title: Accept, pass, or confirm
tutorial.cna.three.body: Accept means you are going. Pass asks a teammate. Confirm means the turn is done.
tutorial.engineer.one.title: This board is raw
tutorial.engineer.one.body: Position, confidence, and area ratios are the engine. They are not a diagnosis.
tutorial.engineer.two.title: Uncertainty is the rest of 100
tutorial.engineer.two.body: Confidence and uncertainty add to 100. A visual check fails when the gate or the alert says so.
tutorial.engineer.three.title: Cameras here are simulated
tutorial.engineer.three.body: Harbor House rows are not a live Tapo. A covered side-of-body label does not reset a timer.
tutorial.director.one.title: Hours are walks not taken
tutorial.director.one.body: Minutes saved are verified checks and merged visits. They are the same number the CNA sees.
tutorial.director.two.title: Ulcers prevented are not estimated
tutorial.director.two.body: There is no incident log and no model here that is allowed to count a prevented injury.
tutorial.director.three.title: A blanket is not a claim
tutorial.director.three.body: Side of body under a cover is not claimed. Gate 1 has not been run.
